description: A shell script that configures Wi-Fi interfaces, restarts hostapd services, manages network settings including DHCP and bridge interfaces, and sets up web server configurations on a router device.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the primary hostapd service by stopping interfaces and killing existing hostapd processes, then starting hostapd with configuration from /nvram.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the 5G hostapd driver modules and services.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Only restarts the hostapd service, mainly for wlan0.
